judged_text: This diff deletes the 'succeeds silently when adding non-existent users' and 'succeeds silently when removing non-members' tests, but the replacement add_members/remove_member actions retain the silent-skip behavior with no replacement assertion anywhere in the rewritten spec (the only test file changed for this controller). add_members still skips unknown usernames without error (and now also silently skips whitespace-padded entries because usernames.split(',') is never stripped) and remove_member no-ops on a non-member user_id; nothing pins that contract, so a future change to 422 on unknown users — or a bug that silently drops real members — ships undetected.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the prior spec assertions that incremental membership changes “succeed silently when adding non-existent users” and “succeed silently when removing non-members” (those examples are deleted from `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb`). In the rewritten controller, the new `add_members` action still silently skips unknown usernames (`user = User.find_by_username(username)` with no else/raise) and also doesn’t strip each `username` after `usernames.split(",")`, so whitespace-padded entries will be ignored. Likewise `remove_member` uses `group.users.delete(user_id)` which is a no-op if the user isn’t a member, and then returns success if `group.save` succeeds. The new specs only cover happy-path add and remove and automatic-group rejection, so these edge-case behaviors are no longer pinned by tests.
